A psychological journey through suspense, supernatural horror, and forbidden desire awaits you. Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses is set to launch later this year—inviting you into a haunted estate where death and longing intertwine at every turn.

[h1]🕯️ A Strange Identity, A Familiar Danger[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/a1cc29ab0506be7dcd344c71f01ac2a3e9405581.jpg[/img]

The story begins in a mysterious century-old mansion, filled with whispers of the dead. The protagonist, An, wakes up after a strange incident—only to realize that everyone sees him as a maid named Anna. Forced to take on this identity, he must carry out daily chores while secretly uncovering the truth about his past. But this house is far from peaceful.

[h1]🔍 A Locked Room, A Vanished Truth[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/3859c9d469eb23e77f375e51eee18398ee2025d1.jpg[/img]

The first murder strikes on the night of a family reunion. The master of the house is found dead in a locked room—his body twisted, the cause unknown. The case seems eerily connected to a long-standing legend within the estate:
Years ago, the master was rumored to have had a secret romance with a maid. When his wife found out, the maid was tormented relentlessly and eventually threw herself into the well. They say her vengeful spirit still wanders the halls, searching for a replacement... to finish what was never avenged.
Was it premeditated murder?Or has something returned... from the well?

[h1]💔 Dangerous Gazes, Tender Lies[/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45434844/e63c76193ae901d105edf0bc451392767af70157.jpg[/img]

Trapped in the guise of a maid and surrounded by suspicion, An finds himself at the center of two men’s growing interest:
Aaron, the calm and distant grandson of the deceased master, quietly watches over him.
Shen Minghao, a mysterious business associate, claims to be there to "save" him.
Can either of them be trusted?
Are they allies, lovers… or the very hands behind the bloodshed?
Every emotion hides a motive.
Every lie has consequences.

[h1]🕸️ Step Into a Nightmare You Can’t Escape[/h1]

Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses is now available for Steam wishlist! More game info, visuals, and demo updates are coming soon. If you love suspense, horror, and emotional BL storytelling, don’t miss this descent into a haunted past.
The truth you seek lies deep in the well…

There was a man named Shogun Jinsai, who set up an experimental facility called the Garden of Light, where he collected war orphans and used them as test subjects to develop special abilities. He then used them as soldiers.

The Southern Army condemned this inhumane practice, and the Northern Army fought each other time and again,

The escapees were Crowe, Rain, Johan and Jeani.
Jeani, however, was captured on his way out.

After the escape, Crowe and his friends set out to find another Garden of Light to prevent more deaths.
For a long time they were unable to find the Garden of Light, although things began to change when they met a woman who called herself Lunaflare,
This leads Crowe and his friends into a major conflict between the northern and southern continents.

Cyclops, the city of eyes, was an ancient city with thousands of years of history, and it was also a pioneer in the transformation of the industrial revolution. On this stage, where history and technology intertwined, the stories of countless characters rose and fell in the noise and silence.

Dr. Etsu wasn't a star of the show or in the limelight, but his role was more dramatic than anyone else's. When he left academia in a state of despair, he was approached by a mysterious woman who called herself a "god" and gave him a pair of eyes with special powers. Years later, relying on the magic of his eyes and his solid medical skills, he became one of the most successful doctors in the city.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/f20934da7d96c566ee35749d6249690ad9eb8195.jpg[/img]

However, perhaps as his price to pay, every night in his dreams, Etsu always found himself in a room without a door, waiting for his patient: the mysterious maiden, Angus.

Angus suffered from an unknown, chronic illness, and no amount of medical expertise could relieve her of her pain, but she still welcomed Etsu's visits with a smile every day. Night after night, the two of them made diagnoses and talked to each other, where Angus learnt about the outside world from Etsu, and Etsu found solace in his contact with the young girl👁️‍🗨️.

In order to find a cure for Angus, Etsu followed the guidance in his dreams and leaped into the various stories of the city of Cyclops. [h1]🐎◆ Story🐎[/h1]

During the Three Kingdoms era, warlords vied for supremacy, aspiring to unify the Central Plains through strategy and warfare. Yet, amidst the continuous conflict, the long-awaited era of peace and prosperity for the common people remained elusive. The chaos of the Three Kingdoms entered its latter stage after enduring years of incessant battles.

In the year 223 AD, on his deathbed, the ailing Emperor Liu Bei entrusted me with the care of his orphaned daughter, Liu Shan, to assist her in ruling and even suggested my intervention in case of her inability to lead. However, as his most loyal advisor, I could not entertain such thoughts. My true aspiration is to groom Liu Shan into a beloved and capable Empress, fostering Shu Han into a powerful nation capable of unifying the realm. This is my life's greatest ambition.

However, nothing unfolds as easily as envisioned. Ambitious stepsons eyeing power, rebellions in the southern regions, rebellious generals, and the invasion by Cao Wei posed successive challenges upon Liu Shan's ascension…

Amidst internal strife and external threats, what choices should I make to lead Shu Han toward an era of peace and prosperity while nurturing Liu Shan to become a wise and benevolent Empress?

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/b0f6d19a744e0ea516e4d606a842c51231eb73cc.png[/img]

[h1]🌟◆ Gameplay🌟[/h1]

Players take on the role of Zhuge Liang, supporting Liu Shan's reign as the Chancellor of Shu Han, nurturing her into an exceptional Empress capable of unifying the realm during tumultuous times. They must navigate the challenges faced by the nation.

Each month in the game allows decisions on two national policies and three arrangements for Liu Shan's development. Policy decisions impact the nation's metrics while nurturing Liu Shan involves choices between "Studying," "Conversations," "Outings," and "Rest," enabling her to lead a balanced life and foster goodwill. Every decision and arrangement influences the destiny of Liu Shan and the nation.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/9113fa692d0581b5e8fe9ff786a7d21f9a9032e1.png[/img]

[h1]👁️‍🗨️◆Story👁️‍🗨️[/h1]

Dr. Etsu wasn't a star of the show or in the limelight, but his role was more dramatic than anyone else's. When he left academia in a state of despair, he was approached by a mysterious woman who called herself a "god" and gave him a pair of eyes with special powers. Years later, relying on the magic of his eyes and his solid medical skills, he became one of the most successful doctors in the city💉.

However, perhaps as his price to pay, every night in his dreams, Etsu always found himself in a room without a door, waiting for his patient: the mysterious maiden, Angus.

In order to find a cure for Angus💊, Etsu followed the guidance in his dreams and leaped into the various stories of the city of Cyclops. The old hero of the old town, the homeless girl of the deserted metal district, the detective on the train, the scholar of the university city… As key supporting characters on this stage, what changes would Etsu bring to their scripts?

The choices you make will affect Angus’ health and the final ending.
Use your eyes’ ability to see into the human body and beyond, into past scenes to learn more about the stories and find clues.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/306579a969d82dd5c8856001196bcb6ebfe2c817.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571820/_/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/21dbb230a0f7e44dfd5ada123cdf81a2206b58a0.jpg[/img]

[h1]🧋◆Story🧋[/h1]
As an engineer, apart from a decent salary, I didn't have any personal life at all, let alone a girlfriend.During the rainy and melancholic winter, a female college girl called "Snow" appeared in my life.🌈

Snow was innocent and lovely – gentle but with a little devilish character. She had a smile like the sunshine, but she looked sad at some points.
Not only did Snow ask to live with me before the end of winter, she also asked to have unprotected sex with me on the first day we met. Claiming it was her first time and asking me to be gentle, she said she was on the pill...?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/350149171b1d0c99cf74d2be757886b1a14f5a75.jpg[/img]

As we lived together and went on trips together, I slowly got to know Snow and became closer to her, but I could still feel that there were many things she did not want to tell me.
She was fine with me doing all sorts of erotic things with her, but never said anything about her feelings for me.
And what about me? What were my feelings for Snow?

When winter passed, would our relationship fade like melting snow, or could I try to make a change…?🌨

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/53109d748d59c730830661caea058c59f6a4d0bf.jpg[/img]

[h1]⛄◆Gameplay Instructions⛄[/h1]
During the days when you live with Snow, you can choose to “Watch TV,” “Chat with Snow,” or “Go out early in the morning” (increase money) on the mornings of workdays.💰 In the evening, you can choose to “Chat” with Snow or to “Have sex.” You can also “Shop online” to buy various clothes and items🛒, which not only allows Snow to "Dress up" but also allows you to start various roleplay scenarios and enjoy your happy days with Snow.On Sundays, you can go on trips with Snow. Every choice you make will have an impact on the final outcome of your relationship with her.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/248c076aadf3cf5ae4db723cf64982693742b392.jpg[/img]

[h1]🎂◆Game features🎂[/h1]
◇25 basic CGs, including more than 300 differentials
◇Game text: 120,000
◇One main female character
◇Romantic simulation game🍰
◇Game endings: 2 types

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/dd946da4de2a02b83bd541fe04fe5cc49fbfb778.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/0304e3f3ce4ebcd518057907abce51f536a92387.png[/img]

[h1]👑◆Story👑[/h1]
Border Conqueror is a visual novel of territorial suppression in which you are the commander, Captain Fetorem, of the Second Legion "winner" Fetorem of the Norman Empire, the most powerful fighting legion in the Empire. You will defend this most dangerous frontier, suppress the rebels, manage or bully newly-conquered territories (and women), and fight against the enemy.🧩

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/bce687c0b514d696e9ee66e4fa667d79d1dc310c.png[/img]

[h1]⛳◆Gameplay⛳[/h1]
The game is a visual novel with strategic elements. Players take on the role of Norman's strongest legion commander and "Attack" to recover territory, then "Transfer" to defend territory. During the battle, "Attack" or "Defend" is decided with reference to "Morale,” where the result of "Morale" determines the victory or defeat of each battle round.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/d3a92a3afb0d57cbe8b4b49b05b97ab7b1d866fe.jpg[/img]

Players can raise "Policing" in the territory to increase recruitment, reduce the chance of bandits, "Recruit," and return to the army barracks for "Training."🎮

When the territory reaches the "Policing" standard, the player will catch 6 women suspected of being spies as the game progresses. The women have attributes such as "Preference," "Dislike," and "Sexual Fetish." The player can use commands such as "Gaze," "Touch," "Kiss," "Hug," "Glare," "Insult," "Lick earlobe," "Kiss chest," "Tease private parts," "Rub butt," "Slap roughly," and "Beat abdomen" on the women to perform foreplay and choose sexual activities like "Penetrate vagina," "Penetrate anus," "Gang rape," etc. Options to have sex include "Thrust gently," "Thrust intensively," "Thrust roughly," and "Ejaculate." Depending on the result of the tutelage, you can raise the "Hentai-level" of the women and decide whether to find the "Spies" to save your life.

In addition, players can have 3 women to "Serve in the bed" in the "Sleeping tent" after dusk.🎯

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35300011/4d93304b6b081b579fcd88df1154f6258f811b13.jpg[/img]

[h1]🧭◆ Game Features🧭[/h1]
◇ War themed, multi-character game. 33 basic CGs, including more than 500 differentials
◇ 3 types of endings (Excluding normal bad endings)
◇ Game text: 100,000🪁
◇ A visual novel with strategic elements, a medieval style game.

After graduation, I lived alone in a big city, far away from home, in order to pursue my dream.🎐
In contrast to the hustle and bustle of the big city, my daily routine and work were always the same, split up by nothing but a daily commute between home and the restaurant I worked for.
I thought I'd just live a quiet life, plain as water, until one day I got a phone call...

The voice on the other end of the line was my mother.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/52d2bdd242f047e7d6288dd92de07a8913af4715.jpg[/img]

"Well, your sister has found a new job, this time in the city where you live, so she'll be coming over to stay with you for a few days. Please take care of her."🍀
Before I could respond, my mother hung up the phone quickly on the other end.
"Ah..." After I put the phone down, I felt restless.

The sister she mentioned on the phone was actually the daughter of my stepfather and his ex-wife. Although we had lived together since we were children, we were more like friends than siblings.
Suddenly, we had to live together for a few days. Even though she was my sister, I couldn't help but feel nervous...

[h2]🍲◆Story🍲[/h2]
The post-war world was awful.
The harsh conditions and repeated witnessing of the most twisted side of human nature could make even the most optimistic person lose the will to survive.🥀

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/928ccd861808b5e866a2d6b4938f73a17919bac2.jpg[/img]

No one would believe it. With this in mind, I met Emma, a young girl who claimed to be a military robot. She asked to come with me and offered to give me everything she had.☔

Emma was strange, with little common sense. She was always expressionless and said that sex was a way to relieve stress. She even initiated physical contact with me and said she was used to it...🪶

What had she been through and what was she hiding?🐦

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/d73aefd62b2e2f3ad85572ec75cff4c00a5df58e.jpg[/img]

After I spent some time with Emma, she gradually took on a different look. The sadness in Emma's eyes was slowly revealed and I began to enjoy her company, forgetting for a while that I was still in the middle of doomsday.🫕

Suffering was approaching. Should we face it or escape? The physical and psychological choices that we had to make were difficult.
Could we really find hope in this desperate doomsday?🌻

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/07186a9ec8343b3ae8ab33614fccd798a6a942d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]🍲◆Gameplay Instructions🍲[/h2]
The game is a combination of exploration, basic combat, and development simulation.
At the beginning of the day, the player can choose a place to “explore,” to “chat” with Emma, or to go further with “physical contact” to increase interaction. As the days pass, more events can be triggered. Differences in Emma's favorability and the player’s choices will lead to different futures.🪺

Remember, the world is in ruins. Your surroundings will always remind you when you accidentally forget.

[h2][b]💄Story💄[/b][/h2]
A fire took away my parents and my happy childhood. The only thing it left me was a piece of charred leather, discovered in the fire, with the words "Chen-Yu News" written on it.

I managed to survive in order to find out the truth behind the fire. Years later, I finally got the opportunity to join Chen-Yu News, provided that I would investigate the truth behind the ‘suicide’ of Su Nian, one of the most popular young actresses in the film industry.

“If you want to become your idol Su Nian, you have to experience what she has gone through.”

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/e802eac0cef43fd5170186edc985fe46884bb4c2.jpg[/img]

The sanctimonious scouts, the malicious agents, and the powerful senpais of the industry...everyone looked at me with greedy eyes and demanded that I “pay” with my body in exchange for opportunities.

The mysterious app “Room S”, the strange purple liquid “soul lose”, etc., all seemed to be piecing together the truth of Su Nian's death.
What had Su Nian gone through? And what did this have to do with Chen-Yu News and the fire in my childhood?

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/61cd060634398dcf0ba4bb94dadc18855e36afae.jpg[/img]

To gather clues in this swamp of desire, should I rot with it, or was there other choices...?

[h2][b]💄Gameplay Instructions💄[/b][/h2]
There are multiple options in the main storyline and each choice will affect the final ending.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/b4bfcf785e3befbc396e9fb665d60f5d90e62e64.jpg[/img]

As the plot develops, explorable areas will gradually open up. The protagonist can choose to [Think] about the current situation, to [Examine] the items she has collected, to [Explore] another location, or to [Take a break] to proceed directly to the main plot in the morning before heading to the designated location. In the process, she gradually collects ‘clues to the truth’ and pieces together the whole story.

[h2][b]💄Game Features💄[/b][/h2]
